capabilities.description: Provides multiple commands for inferring phylogenetic networks using parsimony, likelihood and pseudolikelihood criteria.
Provides commands for species-tree inference from gene trees or sequence data under supported models.
Provides commands for simulation, topology manipulation, scoring and comparison of phylogenetic trees and networks.

input_contracts.format: NEXUS containing data declarations and a PHYLONET command block
Extended Newick declarations when required by the selected command

input_contracts.description: Accepted by commands that operate directly on these data types.

output_contracts.format: PhyloNet textual output, trees, networks, scores or simulated data depending on the selected command

limitations: Outputs and required inputs are command-specific and must be resolved from the complete command reference.
This initial extraction is a high-level index and does not yet encode every PhyloNet command.
The remote command-reference PDF could not be stored locally; source URLs remain registered.
Human review is required before promotion.
